findings.title: Within the documented transaction gas cap
findings.detail: Proposed: 21000 gas. Documented Monad per-transaction maximum: 30,000,000 gas (reviewed 2026-10-10). RPC simulation caps and block gas limits are separate limits.
findings.nextStep: A viable limit must cover the operation and stay within 30,000,000. Never reduce below a verified requirement; reduce or split work and re-estimate if necessary.

explanation.checked: The proposed limit was compared with the documented transaction cap and any successful estimate at the recorded finalized block. Cost uses a separate sampled gas price.
explanation.unknown: The estimate is not a verified universal minimum or a guarantee for future state. No transaction was submitted and no actual fee saving was measured.
explanation.why: Monad charges the submitted gas limit. Too little gas may fail; unnecessary allowance can increase the conditional fee.
explanation.verify: Keep sender, recipient, value and calldata identical. Rerun after adjusting the proposed limit; inspect the new estimate and block timestamp. Do not reduce below a known requirement or clamp an above-cap estimate. Unknown estimates need a successful recheck.

findings.title: Limit matches the RPC estimate
findings.detail: RPC estimate: 21000 gas. Proposed: 21000 gas. An estimate applies to the sampled state and is not a guarantee of future execution.
findings.nextStep: Use a measured limit appropriate to this operation. Re-estimate when state changes; avoid blindly copying large Ethereum-style buffers.
